2608.23419.title: Robustness of IR Models to Collection Growth
2608.23419.paper_summary: Information Retrieval (IR) systems seek to identify relevant documents within a collection. In practical applications, collections are dynamic, with documents frequently added. We argue that ideally, a retriever's effectiveness should not decrease when non-relevant documents are added to a collection. This study formalises this concept and empirically evaluates it by merging two collections with negligible topic overlap. We hypothesise that the way an IR model conditions its ranking on other documents in a collection (e.g., the IDF component in BM25 or contextual documents in listwise rerankers) plays an important role in its robustness to the addition of non-relevant documents. We broadly classify models as those that do not depend on other documents (Multi-Document-Agnostic, MDA) and those that do (Multi-Document-Dependent, MDD). Our results show that neither MDD nor MDA models are fully robust to the addition of non-relevant documents, as all models exhibit some performance degradation. Interestingly, among the models we test, MDA is more effective than MDD for retrieval, whereas MDD and MDA rerankers are equally effective.
2608.23419.paper_summary_zh: 資訊檢索（IR）系統旨在識別集合中的相關文件。<lb/>在實際應用中，集合是動態的，文件經常被添加。<lb/>我們主張，理想情況下，檢索器的有效性在向集合中添加非相關文件時不應降低。<lb/>本研究形式化了這一概念並通過合併兩個主題重疊極小的集合來進行實證評估。<lb/>我們假設，IR模型如何根據集合中的其他文件來調整其排名（例如，BM25中的IDF組件或列表重排序器中的上下文文件）在其對非相關文件的添加的穩健性中扮演著重要角色。<lb/>我們將模型大致分類為不依賴其他文件的模型（多文件無關，MDA）和依賴其他文件的模型（多文件依賴，MDD）。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，無論是MDD還是MDA模型在添加非相關文件時都不是完全穩健的，因為所有模型都顯示出某種性能下降。<lb/>有趣的是，在我們測試的模型中，MDA在檢索方面比MDD更有效，而MDD和MDA重排序器的效果則相當。
